title: 第21章 器纹第22章 坊市
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: “器纹是在材料处理过程中直到最后，通过灵力在材料整体勾织完美的灵脉，进一步激发材料特性并且让法器最终能够被人修使用灵力催动的特殊脉纹，不同的器纹致使法器拥有不同的作用，就像一块寒冰玄铁，它可以被锻造成一把法剑，通过器纹激发它锋利的一面，也可以被锻造成护甲，激发它坚固的一面。”
“而当一件法器是由不同材料组合锻炼时，器纹便是法器链接它们特性的绳索。”
“同时，法印，符文，阵法，禁制等手段皆可融入器纹当中，让法器拥有更丰富的作用。”
“正如储物袋，里面融入了空间阵法，才有了纳巨物之效。”
“世人将器分为法器，灵器，灵宝，便是通过器纹与材料来区分的。”
“因为每位炼器师的灵力与习惯不同，几乎每把法器的器纹都有所区别，器纹也就成了法器的特征。”
陈沫讲完，又从储物戒中拿出一本厚厚的笔扎。
“这本笔扎记载了我炼器以来的经验，里面有许多常见材料的淬炼之法与器纹勾织之法，你先熟悉一二，两日后我正式教导你炼制。”
巫未央已经沉浸在陈沫描述的奇妙器道中，热血澎湃地接过笔扎，恨不得立刻熟知里面的内容。
陈沫见她这样痴狂的神情，欣慰地点了点头，不热爱炼器的炼器师不是好炼器师。
朝天宗两人沉迷炼器，日子过得分外平和时，外面却是热热闹闹，风雨欲来。
所有人都知道，六大宗之间的比拼又将来袭，同时千年一现的秘境也即将开启，这可都是鸿蒙大陆的大事。
六大宗门，青云宗，紫天宗，驭兽宗，丹药宗，器衍宗，流云宗，个个都根基深远，鸿蒙大陆属于人修的地盘几乎都被他们分而统治。
同时他们的纷争也是十分激烈的，即使碍于同族明面上颇为和平，但暗地里的风波却如同滔天巨浪。
正如五年后开启的独属于六大宗门的赛事，繁英大赛。
繁英大赛与青簮会一样，都是每五十年开启，由尚未结婴的宗门弟子参加，通过各式各样的比赛方式，争夺头筹。
这场赛事是六大宗门彰显实力的时候，最初为的是下一次宗门收徒的优先权，如今已经涉及各种资源的优先权，隐隐之中，这场赛事越来越重要。
和平的年代里，他们顾及名声以及人族大全，不得不利用这种相对文雅的方式来进行争夺。
流云宗位于鸿蒙大陆偏北的地方，宗门所在乃平原上的一座巨城，而此刻主殿内的气氛十分僵硬。
“小师弟，三年面壁思过，你仍旧不知悔改，你是要气死师父啊！”
白玉为底，金玉为徽的华丽主殿里，有着三人。
一人独坐高座，闭目假寐，一人跪在殿中央，还有一人站在一旁，正是出言呵斥之人。
王玄风看着倔强的师弟骆丰，头疼不已。
“竹溪秘境只是一个小秘境，存在早已有上千年，里面不知有多少人去过，幼时你也是去过的，怎么那时没发现什么至宝呢？”
“你可知，你毁了竹溪秘境造成了多少人伤亡，这让我们宗门的风评又遭受了多少非议！”
骆丰冷哼一声，“竹溪秘境里的妖兽最高不过三阶，能被这些妖兽杀死的也只是凡人和一些废物，能有什么人为他们主张，无非是青云宗那群伪君子得寸进尺！”
content_en:
"The weapon pattern is a special vein pattern that is used to weave perfect spiritual veins through the entire material through spiritual power during the material processing process until the end, further stimulating the characteristics of the material and allowing the magic weapon to be finally cultivated and activated by spiritual power. Different weapon patterns cause the magic weapon to have different functions, just like a piece of ice black iron. It can be forged into a magic sword, using the weapon pattern to stimulate its sharp side, or it can be forged into armor to stimulate its strong side."
"And when a magic weapon is made from a combination of different materials, the pattern is the rope that connects their properties."
"At the same time, seals, runes, formations, restrictions and other means can be integrated into the weapon patterns, giving the magic weapon richer functions."
"Just like a storage bag, the space formation is integrated into it, so it has the effect of holding giant objects."
"The world divides weapons into magic weapons, spiritual weapons, and spiritual treasures. They are distinguished by the patterns and materials of the weapons."
"Because each weapon refiner has different spiritual power and habits, almost every magical weapon has different patterns, and the pattern has become the characteristic of the magical weapon."
After Chen Mo finished speaking, he took out a thick pen book from the storage ring.
"This book records my experience in refining weapons. It contains methods for tempering many common materials and methods for weaving patterns on weapons. You should familiarize yourself with a few of them first. I will formally teach you how to refine them in two days."
Wu Weiyang was already immersed in the wonderful tools described by Chen Mo. He took the pen with enthusiasm and wanted to be familiar with the contents immediately.
Seeing her crazy expression, Chen Mo nodded happily. A weapon refiner who doesn't love weapon refinement is not a good weapon refiner.
The two Chaotian sects were obsessed with refining weapons and their lives were extremely peaceful, but outside it was bustling and stormy.
Everyone knows that the competition between the six major sects is coming again, and at the same time, the secret realm that appears once in a thousand years is about to be opened. This is a major event in Hongmeng Continent.
The six major sects, Qingyun Sect, Purple Sky Sect, Beast Control Sect, Pill Medicine Sect, Qiyan Sect, and Liuyun Sect, all have deep roots. Almost all the territory belonging to human cultivators in Hongmeng Continent is divided and ruled by them.
At the same time, their disputes are also very fierce. Even though the people of the same clan are quite peaceful on the surface, the turmoil secretly is like huge waves.
Just like the Fanying Competition, a competition unique to the six major sects that started five years later.
The Fanying Competition, like the Qinghui Club, is launched every fifty years, and is attended by sect disciples who have not yet given birth to babies, competing for the top spot through various competition methods.
This competition is a time for the six major sects to show their strength. It was originally for the priority of the next sect to recruit disciples, but now it has involved the priority of various resources. Underneath, this competition is becoming more and more important.
In peaceful times, they took into account their reputation and the entire human race, so they had to use this relatively elegant way to compete.
Liuyun Sect is located in the north of Hongmeng Continent. The sect is located in a huge city on the plain. At this moment, the atmosphere in the main hall is very stiff.
"Junior brother, you have been thinking about your mistakes for three years and you still don't repent. You are going to make Master angry to death!"
There are three people in the gorgeous main hall with white jade as the base and gold and jade as the emblem.
One person was sitting alone on a high seat, closing his eyes and falling asleep. Another person was kneeling in the center of the hall, and another person was standing aside. It was the person who had spoken and scolded him.
Wang Xuanfeng looked at his stubborn junior brother Luo Feng and felt a headache.
"The Zhuxi Secret Realm is just a small secret realm. It has existed for thousands of years. I don't know how many people have been there. You also went there when you were young. Why didn't you find any treasures then?"
"Do you know how many casualties you caused by destroying the Zhuxi Secret Realm, and how much criticism this has caused our sect's reputation!"
Luo Feng snorted coldly, "The highest level of monsters in the Zhuxi Secret Realm is only the third level. The only people who can be killed by these monsters are mortals and some trash. Who can advocate for them is just a group of hypocrites from the Qingyun Sect who are trying to take advantage of them!"
